story_type: launch and booster landing seen from one camera position
hook: This booster went up, then came back down in front of the same camera.
narration: This booster launched a cargo ship toward the space station, then came back down in front of the same camera.
SpaceX's thirty-fourth resupply mission for NASA lifted off from Cape Canaveral on May 15, 2026.
On top, the Dragon capsule carried about sixty-five hundred pounds of science, supplies and equipment.
Then the booster flips around, relights its engines and flies itself home.
outcome: The booster settled onto its legs, and Dragon delivered its cargo.

location_card.place: Cape Canaveral Space Force Station, Florida

title: Rocket launches, then lands in one shot
description:
On May 15, 2026, a SpaceX Falcon 9 launched the Dragon spacecraft on NASA's 34th commercial resupply mission to the International Space Station from Space Launch Complex 40 at Cape Canaveral Space Force Station, Florida.
